mapper.select: SELECT coupon_id, count(coupon_id) as count FROM coupon_issue WHERE Date(created_at) = CURDATE() AND check_related_issued_quantity = 0 GROUP BY coupon_id;
SELECT id FROM coupon_issue WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() AND check_related_issued_quantity = 0;
SELECT id, member_id, coupon_id, coupon_status, created_at, updated_at, check_related_issued_quantity FROM coupon_issue WHERE id = #{id};

SELECT c.id, e.category, e.description, c.discount_type, c.discount_rate, c.discount_price, c.validate_start_date, c.validate_end_date, ci.coupon_status FROM coupon_issue ci JOIN coupon c on ci.coupon_id = c.id JOIN event e on c.event_id = e.id WHERE ci.member_id = #{memberId};

SELECT c.id as couponId, c.validate_start_date, c.validate_end_date, c.discount_type, c.discount_rate, c.discount_price, p.category, p.description, p.min_order_price, ci.id as couponIssueId, ci.coupon_status, p.original_price, p.sale_price FROM coupon_issue ci JOIN coupon c ON c.id = ci.coupon_id JOIN event e ON e.id = c.event_id JOIN product p ON p.category = e.category WHERE ci.member_id = #{memberId} AND #{currentDateTime} BETWEEN c.validate_start_date and c.validate_end_date AND ci.coupon_status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.id = #{productId};
